scope: Source-analysis timing and asynchronous workspace ownership review
coveredCases: Analysis source in-point and speed map to the correct repeated timeline occurrence
Unrelated overlapping clips are never analysis targets
Explicit linked AV peers are included and locked or incompatible links are rejected
Caption source owner is retained during application
Partial whole-clip edits, global ripple, ambiguous move and unselected supporting media are held
Non-finite and out-of-source timeline clocks are rejected
Account and brand changes reject workspace writes and multipart completion
Paid responses are rejected if authentication or cancellation changes during body reading
Old save successes, failures and pending counters cannot contaminate a reloaded workspace
Direct imports reject social pages, redirects, non-video bytes and oversized streams
A decodable picture and measured duration of at most 120 seconds are required
manualReview: VideoAnalyzer queue checks owner, brand, analyzed asset and selected project at the actual mutation
DirectVideoImport changes, cancellation and unmount invalidate pending callbacks
MediaLibrary saves and duration updates recheck upload scope and cancellation
Direct import callback carries its captured upload scope into the Library mutation
Editor chat attachment completion rechecks cancellation and intended project
Autonomous reference callback checks owner, brand and project before saving
limitations: Tests use local mocks and do not authenticate to the owner's production session
No provider generation or account credit debit was performed by this verification
